Framer AI Agents [...] Hey everyone, I’m Faiz, maker of Quello. 👋 I built Quello because my work was scattered across a dozen tools, and finding a single answer meant opening six tabs and hoping someone had documented it. Quello pulls your tools, files, docs, and knowledge into one searchable workspace. You ask a question and get an answer backed by citations, so you can see exactly where it came from instead of taking it on trust. There’s also a voice agent, so you can just talk to your workspace. You can also write your own docs right inside the workspace. A copilot sits alongside you with the context of your entire workspace, so it can help you document things accurately and carefully, drawing on what’s already there instead of starting from a blank page. The part I’m most excited about is MCP support. Your [...] page. The part I’m most excited about is MCP support. Your work context isn’t locked inside Quello. You can connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, and Perplexity, so whichever AI you use already knows how your work fits together. I built this on my own, so your feedback genuinely shapes what comes next. I’ll be here all day replying to every comment. Thanks for checking it out!

Rambox è un'app freemium perfetta. La uso da anni (su Linux, Mac e Windows) e mi trovo molto bene. Quello che apprezzo di rambox sono: la reattività, l'interfaccia grafica che è molto curata (barra laterale) e favorisce il mio flusso di lavoro ed il fatto che il team non è mai venuto meno alla sua vocazione di "offrire" quest'app alle persone. La versione di base è gratuita e finora è rimasta gratuita e questo, per me, vuol dire mantenere una promessa! Cosa che ho apprezzato ed apprezzo. Rambox si interfaccia perfettamente nei vari d.e. (gtk, qt ed altri) e lavora in sintonia con ogni s.o.

Rambox provides an efficient experience for whoever takes care of productivity. It's a bit energy-hungry but there are ways to reduce the impact (these are already good but this aspect can be improved). There are some problems when I want to add custom app because I cannot access specific platforms since the screen remains white (e.g. Notion calendar). Moreover, it could be great to reduce latency when I wake up an app for which the "enable app" option is set. Lastly, I would implement a feature to hide the sidebar on the left and reveal it when I hover over it with the mouse. For the rest I love Rambox! It's amazing
